name: Impossible Cloud Storage
tax_note: The EU pricing page shows EUR prices and does not say whether VAT is included.

regions.note: Listed as US region; the US pricing page (https://www.impossiblecloud.com/en-us/pricing) shows USD 7.99/TB, so EUR prices here are not applied to it.

storage_classes.name: Pay-as-you-go

price.note: Pricing page: EUR 7.99 per TB/month (pay-as-you-go). The storage calculation doc says 1 TB = 1,000 GB and 'EUR 7.99 per terabyte ... is equivalent to EUR 0.00799 per gigabyte.' The page states one price without regional distinction; applied to the EU regions.

put_per_1000.note: Pricing page: 'Free egress and API calls'; FAQ: 'we do not charge for API calls or operational requests.'

get_per_1000.note: Pricing page: 'Free egress and API calls'; FAQ: 'we do not charge for API calls or operational requests.'

list_per_1000.note: Pricing page: 'Free egress and API calls'; FAQ: 'we do not charge for API calls or operational requests.'

price_per_gb.note: No retrieval fee line; the pricing page describes the storage as always hot with free egress and API calls.

typical_delay.note: Not stated; the FAQ describes an always-hot storage model.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: 'No minimum file size or storage duration fees'; FAQ: 'There is no minimum retention period.'

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: 'No minimum file size or storage duration fees.'

notes: Reserved capacity plans (partners only, 1/3/5-year commitment from 25 TB) have a discounted price that is not published.
No monthly minimum or commitment for pay-as-you-go (FAQ).

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: No numeric allowance: egress is free, limited by the fair-use policy (monthly egress up to the active stored volume).

price.note: Pricing page: 'Free egress and API calls', '0€ Egress fees'. Subject to the fair-use policy.

notes: Workloads that regularly need more egress than stored data should contact Impossible Cloud for a custom arrangement (fair-use policy).

egress_fair_use.value: Monthly egress should not exceed the active storage volume (for example 100 TB stored allows up to 100 TB egress per month); excessive requests or transfers that disrupt others are prohibited.
egress_fair_use.note: The pricing page FAQ calls this a 'general rule'.

free_tier.note: No permanent free tier. A 30-day free trial is offered; data is removed when the trial ends. Not modelled.

object_lock.note: Object lock with compliance and governance retention modes and legal hold; requires versioning.
